nuevos.titulo_original: Por qué cambió nuestra comida
nuevos.descripcion:
🥬 Es verdad que muchos alimentos hoy tienen menos micronutrientes que antes, pero no al nivel exagerado que suele circular en redes. La idea de que la espinaca tenía 150 mg de hierro hace un siglo y hoy solo 3 mg viene de datos antiguos y aproximados, que hay que tomar con cautela.

🌱 El problema no parece ser simplemente que “el suelo está agotado”. La explicación más probable es que, durante décadas, seleccionamos variedades de alimentos por rendimiento: producir más por hectárea, crecer más rápido y alimentar a más personas, no necesariamente concentrar más nutrientes.

🧠 Por eso, la solución no es demonizar la espinaca ni obsesionarse con un solo alimento. La clave está en comer más variedad de plantas, porque el problema no es cuánto hierro tiene una hoja específica, sino cuántos alimentos vegetales distintos incluís en tu semana.

nuevos.descripcion:
On September 17, the Defense Health Agency issued clinical guidelines for testosterone deficiency in male service members.

They have added a screening for men 30 and older to the annual health assessment, and evaluation and treatment are voluntary.

My husband and I are two of the four physicians who wrote these guidelines to change that, along with Dr. Larry Lipshultz and Dr. Mohit Khera.

At Strong New York, an audience member asked regarding the guidelines:

“What about women?”

Several viral accusations claim this policy disregards female service members.

This is not true.

Hormone health matters for women too. To me, this work is about meaningful change for my fellow man or woman. Both sexes can do well, and we should want that. It is not either/or.

Since men’s hormones have been studied more, the evidence supported writing their guidelines first.

Optimizing female androgen therapy and overall hormone therapy requires a more nuanced, highly specialized approach than standard male replacement.

But completing these guidelines for men has given us an open door to do the same for women, and we are now helping write the guideline for female service members.

If you would like to learn more, I recently published a podcast episode with my dear friend and incredible advocate Tim Parlatore (this was one of my favorite interviews of all time). Without him these guidelines would not be possible.

Untul este un produs de origine animală obținut prin prelucrarea smântânii. Conține aproximativ 60-80% grăsime. Problema principală este că o proporție importantă din grăsimea untului este reprezentată de grăsimi saturate. Organizația Mondială a Sănătății recomandă ca acestea să reprezinte maximum 10% din aportul energetic zilnic, înlocuirea lor cu grăsimi nesaturate putând aduce beneficii cardiovasculare.

Asta înseamnă că untul este „nesănătos”? Nu chiar. Problema untului nu este că o linguriță ar fi „otrăvitoare”, ci că există grăsimi mai favorabile sănătății cardiovasculare cu care îl putem înlocui. Το μπρόκολο αποτελεί ένα από τα πιο πολύτιμα σταυρανθή λαχανικά στην παραδοσιακή και σύγχρονη διατροφή. Ωστόσο, ο τρόπος με τον οποίο το προετοιμάζουμε και το μαγειρεύουμε στην καθημερινότητά μας επηρεάζει καθοριστικά τη συγκέντρωση των βιοενεργών συστατικών του, όπως η σουλφοραφάνη και οι βιταμίνες.

Σε αυτό το βίντεο εξετάζουμε γιατί το παρατεταμένο βράσιμο σε υψηλές θερμοκρασίες αδρανοποιεί το ένζυμο μυροσινάση, το οποίο είναι απαραίτητο για τη σύνθεση της σουλφοραφάνης. Παρουσιάζουμε τεκμηριωμένες μεθόδους, όπως το ήπιο μαγείρεμα στον ατμό για 3 έως 4 λεπτά, που διατηρούν αναλλοίωτα τα θρεπτικά στοιχεία.

Επιπλέον, αναλύουμε πρακτικές συμβουλές κοπής και ξεκούρασης του λαχανικού πριν από το μαγείρεμα, καθώς και ιδέες συνδυασμού με ελαιόλαδο και λεμόνι για καλύτερη απορρόφηση των λιποδιαλυτών συστατικών, προσφέροντας έναν ολοκληρωμένο οδηγό για καθημερινή ευεξία.

outliers.descripcion:
Brian Grosberg is a world-renowned headache specialist who joins Peter to provide a master class on the diagnosis and treatment of headache disorders. In this episode, Brian explains the distinction between primary and secondary headaches and breaks down the defining features of the "big three" primary headache types (migraine, cluster, and tension headache)—highlighting how often they are misdiagnosed and how they are treated. He explores the epidemiology of headaches, describing migraine as an invisible disease affecting about 12% of the population, disproportionately affecting women, while cluster headaches more often affect men. He discusses the major gap between demand for headache care and available specialists, and he offers advice on when to see a physician. Brian dives into the multifactorial nature and pathophysiology of migraine, including genetic and hormonal influences, neurovascular changes, and inflammatory signaling, and connects these mechanisms to modern therapies. Throughout the conversation, he emphasizes the individualized nature of headache disorders and the importance of a detailed headache diary.
